source_documents.title: Rational design of a red-emissive fluorophore with AIE and ESIPT characteristics and its application in light-up sensing of esterase

reference_evidence_units.quote: powders of 1 emit strong red fluo- rescence
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1
reference_evidence_units.statement: Compound 1 emits at 650 nm with fluorescence quantum yield 24.3%; control powders 2 and 3 have yields below 1%.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Powder values are not solution or probe-4 values; the 2/3 comparison does not identify a unique causal pathway.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The AIE effect of 1 occurs when the water volume fraction in the co-solvent is more than 70%.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 100 micromolar, DMSO/water with 10 mM PBS pH 7.4; excitation 437 nm, Fig. 2.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Green emission in DMSO changes to intense red emission at 90% water; I619/I513 rises above 70% water.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Aggregation is inferred with scattering and main-text-reported DLS (540.4 nm, SI S2); SI not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the deprotona- tion process can improve its solubility.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Aqueous pH 3-13; concentration and pH studies reported from SI S3-S4.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors relate acidic red emission to aggregates and alkaline green emission to increased solubility following deprotonation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Ground-state pH/solubility changes alone do not establish ESIPT kinetics; SI data not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the short fluorescence lifetime in a good solvent
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Main-text account of SI S5: 0% water, 90% water and solid.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Reported lifetimes are 0.2 ns in good solvent, 2.6 ns at 90% water and 3.2 ns in solid. Authors attribute the short solution lifetime to collision-associated nonradiative decay.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The collision explanation is an author assignment without independently resolved rates; not evidence of internal rotational restriction.

reference_evidence_units.quote: ICT has little contribution to the red-shifted emission of 1.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Solvent-polarity control reported from SI S6/Table S1.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Little absorption/emission solvatochromism argues against ICT as the main origin of red-shifted emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This limits ICT's contribution under tested conditions rather than proving absence of all charge redistribution; SI not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: In the crystals of 1, molecules form effective J-aggregates.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors assign J-aggregate packing and attribute emission preservation to ethyl-group steric hindrance and 4.01 angstrom interplanar spacing that weakens quenching pi interactions.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Crystal packing assignment is source-supported; no independently measured exciton dispersion or excimer kinetics.

reference_evidence_units.quote: As for 3, molecules adopt J-aggregate packing pattern
reference_evidence_units.subject: compounds 2 and 3
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Single-crystal and DMSO/water controls, Fig. 3d-e; SI S7-S9 reported.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Compound 2 is bent with 3.25 angstrom spacing; compound 3 has J packing but 3.32 angstrom spacing. Authors assign both ACQ to close pi interactions.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: J packing alone is not sufficient for AIE; comparator distances must not be assigned to 1.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the fluorescent product after reaction between probe 4 and the esterase was isolated by filtration
reference_evidence_units.subject: probe 4 converted to compound 1
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 100 micromolar probe 4, 10 mM PBS pH 7.4, 37 C; product characterization reported from SI S10.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors report isolation and characterization of compound 1 after esterase cleavage of 4; inhibition and selectivity controls concern the reaction-based probe.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The starting analyte is probe 4, not unmodified 1; product identification is reported in main text, SI not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: resulting in 1 with ESIPT and strong fluores- cence in the aggregate states.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Hydroxyl unmasking in the esterase experiment; conclusion and Scheme 1b.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors explicitly assign ESIPT to hydroxyl-bearing compound 1 and associate hydroxyl recovery with aggregate fluorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No time-resolved proton-transfer measurement is supplied in inspected main text; blocking can change multiple properties.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Source identifies intermolecular spacing and suppression of quenching pi contacts as decisive for compound 1, with ACQ controls.

reference_mechanisms.label: ESIPT_PT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Preserve the source's explicit ESIPT assignment and hydroxyl-unmasking rationale; this is not independent ultrafast proof.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The frozen family includes J aggregation. Authors explicitly assign J packing, but compound 3 shows it is not sufficient for AIE; no excimer claim is made.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Do not add RIM from AIE terminology: this paper emphasizes intermolecular spacing, ESIPT and a collision-based solution explanation, not target-specific internal torsional restriction.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Source identifies intermolecular spacing and suppression of quenching pi contacts as decisive for compound 1, with ACQ controls.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No host or analyte binding mechanism changing target emission is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: A substantial ICT explanation of the red shift is explicitly disfavored by the source's solvent control. This does not rule out every CT contribution.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Preserve the source's explicit ESIPT assignment and hydroxyl-unmasking rationale; this is not independent ultrafast proof.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific photoinduced electron-transfer pathway is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The frozen family includes J aggregation. Authors explicitly assign J packing, but compound 3 shows it is not sufficient for AIE; no excimer claim is made.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct radiative-rate or state-population explanation is established; intensity or lifetime changes alone do not isolate it.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet or metal/energy-transfer photophysics is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection pathway is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-state emission or anti-Kasha mechanism is established in this extraction.
